user_rules: 从30以下到30以上并且站上10日线是买入
跌破10线+macd死叉 或者 从70以上跌到70以下卖出+macd死叉
user_confirmation: 状态确认：价格已在10日线下或指标已下穿70，此后MACD死叉时卖出
entry: flat; V_previous<30<=V_current AND adjusted_close>simple_MA10; no requirement for an MA upward crossing on that same day; no MACD entry filter; no inherited bottom setup
exit: held; MACD fresh death-cross today AND (adjusted_close<MA10 OR (this position has observed V>=70 AND V_current<70)); both branches require fresh MACD death-cross, not merely DIF<DEA
top_state: reset on every filled buy and sell; count entry-day close and subsequent held closes; pre-entry V>=70 does not qualify; if V returns to>=70, top branch waits until current V<70 again; prior-day top observation with current<70 implies a past downward crossing

macd.EMA: alpha=2/(period+1), recursive adjust=False; first EMA=first available adjusted close, first DEA=first DIF=0; use all available history before segment
macd.equality: DIF=DEA alone is not a death-cross; closes equal MA10 neither buy nor price-branch sell; V=30 qualifies recovery, V=70 counts as high, current<70 qualifies low side

strategies.OLD_SAME: same entry; sell on close<MA10 without MACD, controls exit-only change
strategies.OLD_WAIT: previous main entry allowing later MA confirmation; sell close<MA10

primary_comparator: MACD_STATE minus OLD_SAME; identical entry condition isolates whole-strategy effect of new exit policy, though different exits change later entry availability
segment_policy: per ETF first available quote on/after start with >=14 closes. Historical holdout is primary; full history/development are secondary, not untouched OOS. Do not annualize segments shorter than365 days.
execution: signal close, next observed per-ETF open; one long/flat position, no same-close fills or pyramiding; segment starts cash=1 without inherited orders; first eligible signal i>=13; positive-volume frozen input only
ledger: reuse frozen prior engine for exact shares, separate non-reinvested dividend reserve, raw OHLC fills/marks, split factors before open, terminal close liquidation estimate charged side fee and labeled forced_end
cost_math: side rate=roundtrip/2; buy shares=trading_cash/(open*(1+side)); sell receives shares*price*(1-side); all baselines pay both ends
dividends: economic entitlement at ex-date into segregated dividend cash/receivable; never reinvest into later buys, no payment-date liquidity assumed
terminal: mark/liquidate remaining shares at final close with estimated side cost; label forced_end separately, do not count it as rule-completed trade
quote_gaps: next available per-ETF quote is execution session, not synthetic filled prices; zero-volume quote cancels that pending execution and reevaluates at close. For aggregated NAV only, forward-fill last mark on missing dates.
aggregation: 9 independent equal-initial-capital subaccounts, no cross-ETF rebalancing; aggregate only primary common period. Also show per-ETF results and all cost cases.

bootstrap.method: resample nonoverlapping joint date blocks of realized aggregate paired log returns; scale by observed sessions/calendar-year; no resimulated signal/price concatenation

historical_return_support_criterion: aggregate net CAGR difference>0, paired date-block CI low>0, majority of same ETFs have positive CAGR difference; never claim future confirmed advantage from this retrospective data

eligible_symbols.label: 科创50
eligible_symbols.group: A股成长，已见过同指数样本

inputs.source_exclusion: 510500 remains excluded for604 adjustment mismatches; no added replacements

limitations: known recent-market and previous indicator work; not genuinely unseen
theoretical daily open/close fills, no orderbook/lot/minimum-fee/limit-queue model
closing-NAV drawdown, not intraday true maximum drawdown
dividends segregated without reinvestment; no actual distribution payment-date ledger
MACD seeded from each ETF available history; 588000 has less than130 observations before2021, so earliest MACD state can depend on seed
no hard stop while awaiting fresh death-cross; a pre-existing bearish MACD state is not a new sell event
